title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Instinct raises $1B at a $10B valuation (Sequoia, Benchmark, Coatue) for consumer task-doing agents
bullets.summary: Personal-agent startup Instinct (founded 2025 by ex-Sierra Noah Shinn) quadrupled its valuation from $2.5B; users text or call it to book, shop and plan, with isolated sandboxes, short-lived local credentials and hallucination detection. Reported Sep 28, so older than 24h; surfaced because the last-24h search returned no verifiable fresh items.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: validates the operator-agent market and the safety pattern (sandbox + short-lived creds + hallucination detection) worth copying into client pitches. The Construct: reference design for credential scoping in Hermes workers. Brand 9 Signs: no direct use.

praxis_lesson: Scan coverage gap: today's search surfaced only one verifiable item, and it was dated. Better to publish a thin, honest report than pad with unverified claims; add daily-digest sources that publish on time (the explainx/techstartups pages 404 until later in the day).
